name: sudus-status
description: Sudus, the referee for agent-led software development, in front of you: the verdict `sudus wake` names next as a status line under the prompt, a pane beside the transcript, or both, with a blobatar face whose expression follows it (thinking while a turn runs, idle with work to do, sad while you owe an answer, happy at Done). Everything is set in settings.json; there is no command. Zero tokens. Needs the sudus command and function hooks (early access).

view.title: Where Sudus shows
view.description: "status-line" (default): one line under the prompt. "pane": a pane beside the transcript with the face. "both". "off": nothing.

face.title: Blobatar face
face.description: The text the face is drawn from; blobatar makes the same face from the same text every time. "sudus" is built in; any other text is fetched from blobatar.dev once per session.

asciiFace.title: ASCII face in the status line
asciiFace.description: Prefix the status line with a small ASCII face in the same expression as the picture.

command.title: sudus command
command.description: The command that runs Sudus; "sudus" on PATH by default.
